subject: general
question:
Which of the following numbers has a terminating decimal?

(15)/(600), (29)/(343), (7)/(2²×7²),(77)/(210)
solution:
**Calculation:**

⇒ 15/600 = 0.025

It is a terminating decimal

⇒ 29/343 = 0.08454....

It is a non - terminating decimal

⇒ 7/2² × 7² = 7/196 = 0.03571...

It is a non - terminating decimal

⇒ 77/210 = 0.3666....

It is a non - terminating decimal

**∴ 15/600 is a terminating decimal**
